facts.fact: Cynthia 满腔怒火，准备去书房与丈夫对质。
facts.anchor: Cynthia was well and truly vexed.

facts.fact: Hubert 未经 Cynthia 同意就辞退了她的女仆，这是她爆发的直接导火索。
facts.anchor: To sack my maid without even bothering to consult me

facts.fact: Cynthia 推开书房门，发现 Hubert 面朝下倒在血泊里。
facts.anchor: He was sprawled face down on the thick Aubusson rug.

facts.fact: 她确认丈夫已经死亡，伸手触碰时脸颊冰冷。
混乱中场景突然被魔法切断，满屋的人瞬间消失。
哥哥 Thomas 出现在她面前，绿眼睛里带着近似恐惧的神色。
facts.anchor: his green eyes flashing with something akin to fear

facts.fact: 哥哥的好友、警司 MacDougal 也在场，手里端着一杯茶。
facts.anchor: Superintendent Lachlan MacDougal. He held a cup of tea in his hands.

facts.fact: 她意识到自己感到的是解脱与自由，而不是丧夫之痛。
facts.anchor: a new understanding sank into her like water into thirsty soil. She was free.
